entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA  CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Arwal P.S. Case No.40 of 2017, registered for the offences under Sections 420 and other allied Sections of the IPC and Section 10 of Bihar Conduct of Examination Act, 1981, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class,
Arwal.
3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
5. Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn.

6. However, if the petitioner surrenders before the learned Court below within six weeks from today and seek regular bail, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.42246 of 2023(3) dt.18-08-2023 the learned Court below shall pass the order, on the same day, in accordance with law, considering the fact that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent and he has been granted the benefit of Section 41A of the Cr.PC.
